title: 第十七章 风雨欲来第十八章 请君入瓮
slug: 凡人修仙苟在废丹房我偷偷成仙了
content_zh:
房内，灵气紊乱。
逆转灵气在孙管事体内乱窜。
原本强悍的气息，也在顷刻间萎靡到低谷。
突破。
失败！
不仅如此，灵气反噬也让他经脉受损。
境界虽勉强维持在炼气二层巅峰，但战力至少跌下三成！
“滚！贱人！给老子滚！！”
咆哮着一掌将三丫拍飞，孙管事连忙盘膝而坐。
此时的他必须全力压制乱窜的灵气，否则就会爆体而亡！
至于这妖女，来日方长便是。
屋外。
三丫借力滚出房门，重重摔在雨地里。
擦掉嘴角血迹，她双眸满是欣喜。
“赌赢了！这肥猪走火入魔了！”
但也并没有放松警惕。
瘦死的骆驼比马大，她一个人，还是没把握。
随即，她目光扫向蹲在角落里啃馒头的李狗蛋。
还有，那个刚推门而入、一脸茫然的护卫张麻子。
......

入夜，李狗蛋的屋内。
“你想活，还是想死？”
站在李狗蛋面前，三丫居高临下道。
直到此刻，她才卸下伪装，展现出属于外门弟子的高傲。
看着眼前这个让他既恨又怕的女人，李狗蛋咬牙道：“我想活！”
“想活就听我的。”
三丫随手扔给他一个小瓶子：
“这是孙管事平日里吃的聚气散，我偷出来的。”
“将这些炼化，下个月必须突破炼气一层！”
“孙肥猪虽然受伤，但留给我们的时间不多。你若不突破，就连当炮灰的资格都没有，只会死在大院里！”
接过瓶子，李狗蛋手在颤抖。
这是自己最后机会。
随着三丫对灵气需求越来越大，他自是没能逃过三丫的魔掌。
原本积攒九十九缕灵气，被吸得只剩下九十四道。
他对丹药的渴望，是致命的。
待三丫走后，李狗蛋迫不及待拔开瓶塞，一股脑将所有丹药吞入腹中。
“给老子破！”
药效化开，灵气在经脉中横冲直撞。
九十五缕......九十八缕......九十九缕！
然而。

无论李狗蛋怎么努力，哪怕经脉痛得要炸开，第一百缕灵气，就是死活凝聚不起来！
“噗！”
content_en:
In the room, the spiritual energy was disordered.
Reversal spiritual energy was flowing wildly in Guanshi Sun's body.
The originally strong aura suddenly withered to the lowest point.
breakthrough.
fail!
Not only that, the backlash of spiritual energy also damaged his meridians.
Although his realm is barely maintained at the peak of the second level of Qi Refining, his combat power has dropped by at least 30%!
"Get out! Bitch! Get out of here!!"
With a roar, he slapped Sanya away with his palm, and Manager Sun quickly sat cross-legged.
At this time, he must suppress the flowing spiritual energy with all his strength, otherwise he will explode and die!
As for this witch, she has a long time to come.
outside the house.
Sanya used her strength to roll out of the room and fell heavily into the rain.
Wiping away the blood from the corner of her mouth, her eyes were full of joy.
"The bet is won! This fat pig has gone crazy!"
But he did not relax his vigilance.
The skinny camel was bigger than the horse. She was still not sure about it alone.
Immediately, she glanced at Li Goudan, who was squatting in the corner and eating steamed buns.
Also, the guard Zhang Mazi who just pushed in the door with a blank look on his face.
...
At night, inside Li Goudan's house.
"Do you want to live or die?"
Standing in front of Li Goudan, Sanya said condescendingly.
It was only at this moment that she took off her disguise and showed the arrogance of an outer disciple.
Looking at the woman in front of him who both hated and feared him, Li Goudan gritted his teeth and said, "I want to live!"
"If you want to live, just listen to me."
Sanya casually threw him a small bottle:
"This is the Qi Gathering Powder that Steward Sun eats on weekdays. I stole it."
"After refining these, we must break through the first level of Qi refining next month!"
"Although Fatty Sun is injured, we don't have much time left. If you don't break through, you won't even be qualified to be cannon fodder, and you will only die in the compound!"
Taking the bottle, Li Goudan's hands were shaking.
This is your last chance.
As Sanya's demand for spiritual energy increased, he could not escape Sanya's clutches.
Ninety-nine strands of spiritual energy were originally accumulated, but only ninety-four were left.
His desire for elixirs was fatal.
After Sanya left, Li Goudan couldn't wait to uncork the bottle and swallowed all the elixirs in his belly.
"Break it on me!"
The effect of the medicine is released, and the spiritual energy rushes through the meridians.
Ninety-five strands...ninety-eight strands...ninety-nine strands!
However.
No matter how hard Li Goudan tried, even if his meridians were so painful that they were about to explode, the hundredth ray of spiritual energy just couldn't be condensed!
"puff!"
